canonical_name: Coldstream data centre campus (The Laundry Field, Stainrigg Mains)
summary: Apatura proposes a circa 300 MW hyperscale data centre campus with a reported 500 MW battery energy storage system on about 69 hectares of arable farmland north and east of Stainrigg Mains Farm, near Leitholm/Eccles, roughly 5 km north-west of Coldstream in the Scottish Borders. Scottish Borders Council issued an EIA screening opinion (25/00556/SCR, decided 4 July 2025) determining that an Environmental Impact Assessment is not required. As of 30 July 2026 no PAN or full planning application for the campus could be found on the council portal (via PlanIt).
maturity_explanation: Early development only: an EIA screening request (25/00556/SCR) was submitted 7 May 2025 and determined 4 July 2025 (EIA not required). Press reporting (July 2025) stated full applications for the data centre and BESS had not yet been submitted, and no PAN or full application was found on the Scottish Borders portal via PlanIt as of 30 July 2026.

latest_development.headline: Scottish Borders Council screening opinion: EIA not required for proposed data centre campus at Stainrigg Mains
